text:
sam peters: FYI I'm about to apply a small terraform change to add a namespace + serviceaccount for the analytics batch job. plan looks clean — pinging here for quick checks.

maria chen: Thanks — what's the SA annotation for? IRSA role?

sam peters: Yes, eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn -> arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-analytics-role

alex nguyen: Quick Q: are we using projected service account tokens (OIDC) or the annotation-based IRSA? we should rely on IRSA (annotated role) + projected tokens via kubelet.

luis garcia: For the secrets wiring: will the job read from k8s Secret or AWS Secrets Manager? if ASM, ensure iam policy allows secretsmanager:GetSecretValue and kms:Decrypt. also confirm the KMS key ARN.

sam peters: ASM. I'll attach a minimal policy to the role. Terraform snippet in the PR: 
```
resource "kubernetes_namespace" "exp" {
  metadata { name = "redwood-experiments" }
}
resource "kubernetes_service_account" "analytics" {
  metadata {
    name = "analytics-svc"
    namespace = kubernetes_namespace.exp.metadata[0].name
    annotations = {
      "eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn" = aws_iam_role.redwood_analytics.arn
    }
  }
}
```

maria chen: One more: set automountServiceAccountToken = false on SA? the job uses the AWS SDK and needs a token for ASM access via IRSA — so keep automountServiceAccountToken true. but we should scope the token TTL appropriately (check projected token lifetime).

alex nguyen: We generally leave automount true for pods that talk to AWS. If this is a short-lived CronJob, TTL is less of a concern, but good to document.

devops-bot: terraform plan finished: 3 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy. plan id: plan-xyz

sam peters: I'll run apply after @maria okays the secrets policy. @maria any blockers?

maria chen: Looking now. Can you include the policy JSON in the PR? I want to vet the KMS key ARN and ensure least-privilege (prefer secretsmanager:GetSecretValue + kms:Decrypt only). Also add an explicit statement about who owns the namespace.

luis garcia: Also, do we need a RoleBinding in the namespace for the SA to read ConfigMaps or watch resources? if the job only calls AWS, maybe not. but include an example RoleBinding in the PR to be safe.

sam peters: good call. PR will include rolebinding example. snippet: 
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: analytics-read-cm
  namespace: redwood-experiments
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: analytics-svc
  namespace: redwood-experiments
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: read-configmaps
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```

maria chen: LGTM — please add the policy and I'll approve. also post a short note in #help so SRE knows who owns the namespace and the retention policy. :+1:

sam peters: will do. thanks everyone, applying in ~10m unless objections.

alex nguyen: no objections from me. :shipit:

sam peters: apply done. plan id plan-xyz, output: applied 3 resources. tagging as infra-change for audits.

devops-bot: deploy event: terraform apply by sam peters at 1765560500

maria chen: Thanks — checking job logs now to confirm SA can read secret.

maria chen: confirmed, job pulled secret from ASM and ran successfully. closing the loop. :tada:
